studioAgent.description: Which Facilio Studio agent should handle this request.

message.description: The message to send to that Studio agent, restating the user's intent with the concrete values it needs.

srId.description: The service request record id this concerns.

rationale.description: One sentence on why this Studio agent was chosen.

missingInfo.description: Values the Studio agent will need that the user has not supplied yet. Empty when nothing is missing.
